> Route returned a `RETURNED_VALUE`. Only a Response can be returned from PPHLX files.

## What went wrong?
Only instances of [Response](https://developer.mozilla.org/en-US/docs/Web/API/Response) can be returned inside PPHLX files.
```pphlx title="pages/login.pphx"
{|
return new Response(null, {
 status: 404,
 statusText: 'Not found'
});

// Alternatively, for redirects, `PPHLX.redirect()` also returns an instance of `Response`
return PPHLX.redirect('/login');
|}
```

**See Also:**
-  [Response](/en/guides/on-demand-rendering/#response)
